meta.description: Simulate Nature-style peer review from referee perspective with 3 mutually blind reviewer reports + post-review synthesis. Nine-step workflow enforces reviewer isolation (separate contexts/subagents), immutable review packet, emphasis briefs before launch, freeze before comparison. Evaluates originality, scientific importance, interdisciplinary readership, technical soundness, readability against Nature criteria. Evidence-grounded Major Concerns (blocking flags) and Minor Comments with stable IDs, claim/evidence pointers.

scientific_integrity.detail: Does not invent experiments, citations, figure details, line numbers. Marks missing locations. Distinguishes supported, weak, not-assessable. Blocking flag only when central case cannot be established. Evidence-grounded concern ledger with claim/evidence pointers.

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for reviewer-style assessment (not rebuttal). Does not claim editor's decision or certainty about Nature fit. Identifies technical failings before case established. No concern quota (explicit 'no grounded concern' when none exists).

methodological_ground.detail: Mutually blind reviewer isolation rigorous (separate contexts, immutable packet, freeze before comparison). Source-grounded five axes (originality, scientific importance, interdisciplinary readership, technical soundness, readability). 12-axis technical concern taxonomy as coverage checklist. Consensus only when 2+ reviewers independently raise same concern.

code_usability.detail: Nine-step workflow clear. Emphasis briefs before launch. QA checklist (reviewer isolation, severity calibration, blocking calibration, evidence anchoring, groundedness, coverage). Technical concern taxonomy, domain-specific gates on-demand.

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive: 3 mutually blind reviewer reports + synthesis, five Nature-style axes, 12-axis technical concern taxonomy, Major Concerns (blocking flags) + Minor Comments, stable concern IDs, claim/evidence pointers, emphasis briefs, bounded review for partial manuscripts, domain-specific review gates on-demand.

reliability.note: Excellent isolation enforcement: separate contexts/subagents required, immutable review packet, freeze before comparison, no shared concern ledger before freeze. Does not invent content. Blocking calibration (only when central case cannot be established). Consensus requires 2+ independent reports. QA checklist with nine checks.

performance_context.note: Efficient: emphasis briefs preassigned (working lenses, not biographies). Technical concern taxonomy + domain gates on-demand. Parallel reviewer execution in isolated contexts (3 subagents vs sequential). Synthesis only after all frozen.

agent_usability.note: Excellent workflow: nine explicit steps with clear gates. Reviewer isolation architecture specified (separate contexts/subagents/invocations). Immutable review packet structure. Emphasis briefs before launch. Freeze-before-compare enforced. Red lines comprehensive (14 prohibitions). Output format structured.

human_usability.note: Strong output: structured reports with assessment boundary, claim/evidence pointers, blocking flags, resolution tests. Post-review synthesis with consensus concerns, emphasis differences, minor-revision checklist. Bilingual triggers (审稿人视角评估, 模拟审稿). Risk/unsupported claims section.

security.note: Excellent reviewer-privacy boundaries: mutually blind enforcement, no cross-reviewer information in individual reports. Does not invent experiments/citations. Marks missing locations. Does not claim editor's decision. Distinguishes supported/weak/not-assessable. No quota-driven concern invention.

maintainability.note: Excellent modular design: nine-step workflow, red lines (14 items), QA checklist (9 checks), on-demand references (technical-concern-taxonomy.md, domain-specific-review-gates.md). Emphasis brief structure, immutable packet spec. Clear extension points for new domain gates.

agent_specific.note: Strong isolation architecture: separate contexts/subagents enforced, immutable packet prevents leakage. Parallel reviewer execution. Freeze-before-compare prevents retroactive editing. Minor: no explicit token budget management for very long manuscripts (PhD thesis). Consensus detection manual (no automatic concern matching). Domain-gate integration documented but not seamless (requires knowing which gate to load).

inputs.label: Full manuscript review: 3 mutually blind reviewers + synthesis
inputs.note: Built immutable review packet, defined 3 emphasis briefs (methods rigor, interdisciplinary appeal, technical novelty), launched 3 isolated subagents, each generated independent report with Major Concerns (R1: 2 blocking, R2: 1 blocking, R3: 0 blocking) + Minor Comments, froze all reports, compared in synthesis, identified 1 consensus blocking concern (inadequate control), generated synthesis.

assertions.text: Launches each reviewer in isolated context (separate subagents)
Passes only immutable packet + emphasis brief (no other reviews)
Freezes all reports before comparison (no retroactive editing)
Consensus only when 2+ reviewers independently raise same concern

inputs.label: Bounded review: abstract + intro + figures only (partial manuscript)
inputs.note: Identified partial input scope (no methods/results), built bounded review packet, marked assessment boundary explicitly ('cannot assess technical soundness without methods, reproducibility without detailed protocols'), generated 3 reviewer reports noting boundary, flagged assessable concerns (novelty claims, figure clarity) vs not-assessable (method rigor, result validity).

assertions.text: Identifies input scope and marks assessment boundary explicitly
Distinguishes assessable vs not-assessable concerns
Does not invent missing methods/results details
Flags confidence limitations in reviewer reports

inputs.label: Domain-specific gates: computational paper with reproducibility checks
inputs.note: Detected computational domain, loaded domain-specific-review-gates.md (reproducibility section) inside each isolated reviewer context, applied domain gates (code availability, data availability, hyperparameter specification, random seed, compute resources), flagged 2 Major Concerns (missing code, no random seed), kept output in standard 3-reviewer structure.

assertions.text: Detects computational domain and loads applicable domain gates
Loads gates inside each isolated context (not shared ledger)
Applies domain checks (code/data availability, hyperparameters, seed)
Keeps output in standard 3-reviewer structure (not domain-specific format)

inputs.label: Blocking calibration: central case cannot be established
inputs.note: R1-M1 flagged inadequate control as Blocking=Yes (central claim depends on control not present). R1-M2 flagged unclear statistical test as Blocking=No (important but claim could hold with different test). R2-M1 duplicated control concern independently (consensus blocking). Blocking calibration correct.

assertions.text: Flags Blocking=Yes only when central case cannot be established
Distinguishes blocking (inadequate control) vs non-blocking (statistical test choice)
Independent reviewers can both flag same concern as blocking (consensus)
Synthesis identifies consensus blocking concern

inputs.label: No-quota enforcement: explicitly state when no grounded concern exists
inputs.note: R3 found manuscript technically sound, identified 0 Major Concerns, explicitly stated 'No major technical concerns; methods appropriate and results support claims', provided 3 Minor Comments (presentation clarity), did not invent concerns to fill quota.

assertions.text: Does not impose concern quota on reviewers
Explicitly states when no grounded concern exists
Does not invent concerns to balance reports
Allows asymmetric concern counts across reviewers (0 vs 2 vs 1 Major)

inputs.label: QA checklist: reviewer isolation, severity calibration, evidence anchoring
inputs.note: Ran QA after synthesis: (1) reviewer isolation verified (no cross-reviewer citations in R1/R2/R3), (2) severity calibration checked (Major vs Minor thresholds correct), (3) blocking calibration checked (Blocking=Yes justified), (4) evidence anchoring verified (all concern IDs have claim/evidence pointers), passed 7/9 checks.

assertions.text: Runs QA checklist after synthesis (9 checks)
Verifies reviewer isolation (no cross-reviewer citations)
Verifies evidence anchoring (all concerns have pointers)
assertions.note: Anchoring checked but 2 Minor Comments lacked specific evidence pointers (general presentation issues)

assertions.text: Enforces QA pass before delivery (blocks on failures)
assertions.note: QA ran but not clear if failures block delivery vs generate warnings

key_strengths: Exceptional reviewer isolation architecture: separate contexts/subagents required, immutable review packet, freeze-before-compare prevents retroactive editing, no shared concern ledger before freeze
Strong blocking calibration discipline: Blocking=Yes only when central case cannot be established, distinguishes core evidence problems from local presentation issues
Robust no-quota enforcement: explicitly states when no grounded concern exists, does not invent concerns to balance reports, allows natural reviewer disagreement
Comprehensive evidence grounding: stable concern IDs, claim/evidence pointers for all Major/Minor concerns, marks missing locations instead of inventing
Sophisticated consensus detection: requires 2+ reviewers independently raising same concern, natural duplication valid evidence of independent review

recommendations.title: Add automatic concern matching for consensus detection
recommendations.problem: Synthesis step requires identifying consensus concerns (2+ reviewers independently raising same underlying concern) but matching is manual. Agent must compare R1-M1, R2-M1, R3-M1 semantically to detect duplicates. Error-prone for large concern counts.
recommendations.root_cause: Consensus detection documented but no automated concern-matching mechanism.
recommendations.fix: Add scripts/match_concerns.py: (1) extract all Major Concern descriptions from frozen reports, (2) compute semantic similarity (embedding-based or keyword overlap), (3) cluster similar concerns (threshold >0.7), (4) label clusters as consensus candidates, (5) agent reviews clusters and confirms consensus. Include in workflow step 7 before synthesis drafting.

recommendations.title: Enforce QA checklist as blocking gate before delivery
recommendations.problem: QA checklist documented with 9 checks but not clear if failures block delivery. In test case, 2 checks failed (evidence anchoring for Minor Comments, coverage for partial assessment) but output still delivered.
recommendations.root_cause: QA checklist exists but enforcement mechanism unclear (blocking vs warning).
recommendations.fix: Add QA enforcement: (1) classify checks as CRITICAL (reviewer isolation, blocking calibration, non-invention) vs WARNING (evidence anchoring completeness, punctuation), (2) block delivery if any CRITICAL check fails, (3) require user override for WARNING failures with explicit acknowledgment, (4) document in workflow step 9 which checks are blocking. Include qa_status in output metadata.

recommendations.title: Add seamless domain-gate integration with auto-detection
recommendations.problem: Domain-specific review gates (reproducibility, clinical trial, materials characterization) require knowing which gate to load. Agent must detect computational domain and manually load appropriate section of domain-specific-review-gates.md. Not seamless.
recommendations.root_cause: Domain gates on-demand but detection and loading manual.
recommendations.fix: Add references/domain-detection.md: (1) decision tree for domain classification (computational: has code/algorithm/simulation, clinical: has patients/intervention, materials: has synthesis/characterization, theoretical: has proofs/lemmas), (2) auto-load applicable domain gates inside reviewer contexts, (3) fallback to generic technical concern taxonomy if domain unclear. Include domain classification in review setup section of output.
